text.p: Chicago's futures and options exchanges said they will observe the following schedules for the U.S. Veteran's Day holiday Nov 11:

At Chicago Mercantile Exchange (CME), all contracts close at noon Nov 11 except Goldman Sachs Commodity Index and equity index products, which will trade their normal hours. GLOBEX trading will open at 1730 CST/2330 GMT.
CME contracts will trade normal hours Nov 8.
Nov 8, Chicago Board of Trade (CBOT) financial and insurance contracts will close early at 1210 CST but agricultural and metals contracts will trade normal hours.
CBOT on Nov 11 will observe normal trading hours.
On Nov 10, CBOT evening pit trading will be closed. Overnight Project A session will be open for agricultural products but closed for financial products.
At Chicago Board Options Exchange (CBOE), trading will observe normal hours Nov 11 except for interest-rate options, which will be closed.
Nov 8, CBOE contracts will trade normal hours except interest-rate options, which will finish at noon CST. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750 E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
